    # New small targeted edit: deterministic inter-route swap (1-1) with capacity feasibility
    def swap_first_improvement():
        loads = [route_load(rt) for rt in routes]
        # Prefer swapping from expensive routes
        order = list(range(len(routes)))
        order.sort(key=lambda idx: (route_cost(routes[idx]), idx), reverse=True)

        for a_idx_pos in range(len(order)):
            i = order[a_idx_pos]
            r1 = routes[i]
            if not r1:
                continue
            load1 = loads[i]
            for j in range(len(routes)):
                if j == i:
                    continue
                r2 = routes[j]
                if not r2:
                    continue
                load2 = loads[j]

                # Candidate pairs: scan in deterministic order, stop at first improving swap
                for p in range(len(r1)):
                    x = r1[p]
                    new_load1 = load1 - demands[x]
                    if new_load1 + demands[x] == load1:
                        pass  # no-op, keeps structure simple

                    a_prev = depot if p == 0 else r1[p - 1]
                    a_next = depot if p == len(r1) - 1 else r1[p + 1]
                    cur1 = matrix[a_prev][x] + matrix[x][a_next]

                    for q in range(len(r2)):
                        y = r2[q]
                        if new_load1 + demands[y] > capacity:
                            continue
                        if load2 - demands[y] + demands[x] > capacity:
                            continue

                        b_prev = depot if q == 0 else r2[q - 1]
                        b_next = depot if q == len(r2) - 1 else r2[q + 1]
                        cur2 = matrix[b_prev][y] + matrix[y][b_next]

                        new1 = matrix[a_prev][y] + matrix[y][a_next]
                        new2 = matrix[b_prev][x] + matrix[x][b_next]

                        delta = (new1 - cur1) + (new2 - cur2)
                        if delta < 0:
                            # Apply swap
                            routes[i][p] = y
                            routes[j][q] = x
                            loads[i] = load1 - demands[x] + demands[y]
                            loads[j] = load2 - demands[y] + demands[x]
                            return True
        return False

    # 2) Iterate a few rounds: 2-opt locally then relocate across routes (and swap)
    desc = instance.get("descriptors", {})
    demand_pressure = desc.get("demand_pressure", 1.0)
    corridor = desc.get("corridor", 0.0)
    trap = desc.get("trap", 0.0)

    max_outer = 2
    if demand_pressure >= 0.97:
        max_outer = 3
    if trap >= 0.07 or (corridor is not None and corridor > 0.3):
        max_outer = 3

    for _ in range(max_outer):
        for rt in routes:
            if len(rt) >= 4:
                for __ in range(2):
                    if not two_opt_best_improvement(rt):
                        break

        for __ in range(8):
            if not relocate_first_improvement():
                break

        # Swap is more effective on clustered/bottleneck instances; keep bounded
        for __ in range(6 if demand_pressure >= 0.97 else 4):
            if not swap_first_improvement():
                break

    # 3) Optional simple split/merge stabilization near vehicle hint
    if vehicle_hint and vehicle_hint > 0:
        nonempty = [i for i, r in enumerate(routes) if r]
        if len(nonempty) > int(vehicle_hint * 1.35):
            loads = [route_load(rt) for rt in routes]
            idxs = [i for i in range(len(routes)) if routes[i]]
            idxs.sort(key=lambda i: (loads[i], i))
            for ri in idxs:
                r_from = routes[ri]
                if not r_from:
                    continue
                moved_any = False
                for pos in range(len(r_from)):
                    v = r_from[pos]
                    a = depot if pos == 0 else r_from[pos - 1]
                    c = depot if pos == len(r_from) - 1 else r_from[pos + 1]
                    rem_cur = matrix[a][v] + matrix[v][c]
                    rem_new = matrix[a][c]
                    rem_delta = rem_new - rem_cur

                    best = None  # (delta, rj, ins)
                    cand = [j for j in range(len(routes)) if j != ri]
                    cand.sort(key=lambda j: (route_cost(routes[j]), j))
                    for rj in cand:
                        if loads[rj] + demands[v] > capacity:
                            continue
                        r_to = routes[rj]
                        to_n = len(r_to)
                        for ins in range(to_n + 1):
                            if to_n == 0:
                                ins_cur = 0
                                ins_new = matrix[depot][v] + matrix[v][depot]
                            elif ins == 0:
                                left = depot
                                right = r_to[0]
                                ins_cur = matrix[left][right]
                                ins_new = matrix[left][v] + matrix[v][right]
                            elif ins == to_n:
                                left = r_to[-1]
                                right = depot
                                ins_cur = matrix[left][right]
                                ins_new = matrix[left][v] + matrix[v][right]
                            else:
                                left = r_to[ins - 1]
                                right = r_to[ins]
                                ins_cur = matrix[left][right]
                                ins_new = matrix[left][v] + matrix[v][right]
                            delta = rem_delta + (ins_new - ins_cur)
                            if best is None or delta < best[0]:
                                best = (delta, rj, ins)

                    if best is not None and best[0] < 0:
                        # Apply move
                        route_remove_at(r_from, pos)
                        dest_route = routes[best[1]]
                        route_insert_at(dest_route, best[2], v)
                        loads[ri] -= demands[v]
                        loads[best[1]] += demands[v]
                        moved_any = True
                        break

                if moved_any:
                    routes = [r for r in routes if r]
                    if len(routes) <= int(vehicle_hint * 1.35):
                        break

    return routes
